input.summary: Cap the Company-payable Termination Payment at three months' fees and disapply it where we terminate for HDI's breach
input.comment: [Playbook] We do not accept liquidated damages or penalties payable by the Company, so we have replaced the Net Sales-based formula with our fallback: a termination amount capped at three months' fees, and no such payment where we terminate for HDI's breach. As drafted the payment (50% of Net Sales above $800,000) could far exceed the fees remaining on a one-year, 90-day-notice term.

ops.oldText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
ops.newText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, other than as a result of HDI's breach of this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate fees payable by the Company to HDI pursuant to Section 3.1 in respect of the three (3) calendar months immediately preceding the Termination Date, which amount shall be the sole and exclusive amount payable by the Company in connection with such termination.
